tasks.description: Research and decide on a payment provider to use for the application. This will involve evaluating different options and selecting the one that best fits the needs of the project. The chosen provider should support multiple currencies and have a robust API for integration.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of payment providers, when the team evaluates them, then the best provider is chosen based on project needs.

tasks.description: Work with finance to determine the plan tiers and their corresponding prices. This will involve deciding on the different levels of service and the cost associated with each one.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of plan tiers, when the prices are assigned, then the pricing structure is well-defined and consistent.

tasks.description: Design and implement an API for handling payments. This will involve creating endpoints for payment processing and integrating with the chosen payment provider.
acceptance_criteria: Given a payment request, when the API is called, then the payment is processed successfully and the result is returned.

tasks.description: Research and implement tax handling for payments. This will involve determining the tax rates for different regions and integrating with the payment API.
acceptance_criteria: Given a payment request, when the tax is calculated, then the correct tax amount is added to the payment total.

tasks.description: Work with legal to develop a refund policy for the application. This will involve determining the conditions under which a refund can be issued and the process for handling refunds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a refund request, when the policy is applied, then the refund is processed correctly and the user is notified.

tasks.description: Design and implement a user interface for handling payments. This will involve creating a payment form and integrating with the payment API.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when they navigate to the payment page, then the payment form is displayed and the user can enter their payment information.

tasks.description: Integrate the payment system with user accounts. This will involve updating the user's account status when a payment is made and ensuring that the payment is tied to the correct account.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when they make a payment, then the payment is tied to their account and their account status is updated.

tasks.description: Test the entire payment workflow to ensure that it is working correctly. This will involve testing the payment API, the payment UI, and the integration with user accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when they navigate through the payment workflow, then the payment is processed successfully and the user's account is updated.
